question: How much will Gold Futures total price returns exceed S&P 500 Futures in these biweekly periods of Q4 2026? (Nov 9 - Nov 20)

calls.reasoning: This is the GC return minus the ES return from the Nov 6 close to the Nov 20 close (10 trading days). Two-week gold-vs-S&P gaps have historically centred near zero with no reliable sign. Volatility is elevated going in: on Oct 30 the gold volatility index (GVZ) was 26 and the VIX was 19.4. Gold broke below $4,000 and its 200-day moving average and is down about 6% over the past month. Tech stocks sold off at the end of October and oil spiked on a Strait of Hormuz attack. Gold's downward momentum and a possible oversold rebound roughly cancel, so the median is near 0. Fat tails justify about 5.5% total probability outside ±10 pp. Market check: the harness title search of Polymarket and Manifold found no market; this run did not search Kalshi or bookmakers.
calls.dossier:
- Resolves off Yahoo Finance GC=F and ES=F daily closes, not spot gold or the cash S&P 500 index. Quantity is GC % return minus ES % return; P0 = close on the last trading day before Nov 9 (Fri Nov 6), P1 = close Nov 20.
- Event window: Nov 6 close -> Nov 20 close per the criteria; as of Nov 2 0% elapsed. The start price is not yet set, so moves Nov 2-6 do not count.
- Gold near $3,901 on Nov 2 (+0.65% on the day), down about 5.8% over one month and about 2.5% year over year (tradingeconomics, Nov 2 2026).
- Gold broke below $4,000 and its 200-day moving average in late October; the selloff was tied to forced liquidation after a tech stock rout, rising Treasury yields and a strong dollar (fxleaders, Nov 1 2026; mitrade). One source cites an intraday low near $3,589, which may be inconsistent with other quotes.
- The Fed held at 3.75-4.00% on Oct 28. Brent at about $117 after a vessel attack in the Strait of Hormuz (mitrade, late Oct 2026); oil fell on Nov 2.
- Stocks: Nasdaq-100 fell 3.46% on Fri Oct 30, the worst week in months; S&P 500 futures were up about 0.3-0.5% premarket on Nov 2 (Schaeffer's, TipRanks, Nov 2 2026).
- Volatility on Oct 30: GVZ 26.15 (+15% on the day), VIX 19.42 (+13%) (Yahoo/Cboe). Implied 10-trading-day SD: gold about 5.2%, S&P about 3.9%.
- Upcoming: US midterms Nov 3 and jobs report Nov 6 (both before the window starts); data releases and Fed speakers within the window.
- Base rate: two-week GC minus ES gaps in 2025-2026 have centred near 0 with an SD of about 3.5-5 pp (gold realized volatility rose sharply in 2025-26). The Metaculus example period (Jun 9-20 2025) resolved at +1.31.
- Correlation between gold and stocks was recently positive during liquidation (both fell together), which narrows the spread; in risk-off flight-to-safety episodes they move apart.
- Searched and not found: any Polymarket, Kalshi or Manifold market on this spread; a Kalshi/bookmaker search was not completed; the Metaculus spreadsheet of past periods was not accessed.
